name: FlipFilterGrid
job: Pill chips that filter a set of raised tiles by category while the tiles morph to their new places with a big springy FLIP
visitor_action: click/tap one or more chips; Esc clears
motion: tiles spring to new slots with overshoot and velocity tilt, new ones burst out from the board centre, hidden ones shrink into it (reduced-motion: instant filter)
art_direction: Soft-UI tray: clay #e7e4dc, raised tiles #efece6 with paired light/dark shadows, pill chips that press in when active (accent #C2381B dot); Fraunces titles + JetBrains Mono meta. One big move: an underdamped FLIP morph where entering tiles burst out from the board centre, leavers collapse into it, and movers overshoot and tilt with their velocity.
